| # | Description | Level | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **7.2.5** | [MODIFIED, MOVED FROM 11.1.8] Verify that the application has configurable alerting when unusual or malicious activity is detected. | 2 | 390 |

First, is alerting in scope of ASVS?

I watch it as - the application needs to be able to detect and log security events, but alerting as such is responsibility for other system and it is out of scope of ASVS.

If there is agreement, we need to cover it in the section text somewhere in V7.

If this requirement is considered in scope, it is anyway problematic:

  * how do you verify and what is "configurable"?
  * "unusual or malicious activity" is vague as well, probably covered by current 8.1.4 (see #2629) or requirements in V7.2 section

I propose to delete 7.2.5 as out of scope.

comments.body: This is a good argument. I agree this is out of scope and should be deleted.
I think we should delete this, merge 8.1.4 into 7.2.4 and make it clearer that this sort of alerting is out of scope although the logging is in scope.
I created a commit so now we are waiting for a resolution on #2629
